newsitem.title: USA: ITT Hartford says unit files for IPO.
newsitem.headline: ITT Hartford says unit files for IPO.

text.p: ITT Hartford Group Inc said it filed for an initial public offering of up to 20 percent of the common stock of Hartford Life Inc, a provider of investment products such as annuities, mutual funds and pension products.

Hartford Life had assets of $80 billion at the end of 1996 and is the eight largest U.S. life insurance group, ITT Hartford said in a statement. It will continue to be one of ITT Hartford's five key businesses.
ITT Hartford would own at least 80 percent of Hartford Life after the IPO, expected during the second quarter.

The deal will be lead-managed by Goldman Sachs & Co, which will also include Dean Witter Reynolds Inc, Merrill Lynch & Co, Morgan Stanley & Co Inc and Smith Barney Inc, the company said in a statement released on Monday.

"The offering will enhance the group's shareholder value by recognizing the market value of our life operations and strengthening the Hartford' financial position," said Ramani Ayer," chairman and chief executive of ITT Hartford.
Shares of ITT Hartford closed on Friday at 75-1/4.
